description: List Zoom meetings for the signed-in user (upcoming, scheduled, or currently live video calls). Returns compact meeting summaries (id, topic, start time, duration, join URL, timezone). Use to browse a user's Zoom meetings.

page_size.description: Maximum number of meetings to return (default 30, max 100).

type.description: Which set of Zoom meetings to list: "scheduled", "live" (currently in progress), or "upcoming" (default).

name: zoom_list_meetings
title: Zoom List Meetings
